reference.criterion: Software supplies enough instruction that teachers primarily handle motivation, well-being and socialization.
reference.rationale: Classroom software was real, but the human teacher’s principal instructional role had not generally been displaced in 2009. Digital materials and AI help instruction, yet human teachers remain central knowledge instructors. The claimed role rebalancing remains partial, not merely awaiting a perfect survey.
